pages.title: The Leviathan
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Sunken City: the Leviathan's tidal claws, abyssal egg and sacrifice, the coral spear and bardiche, crystallised coral, the deeplings' athame and the lionfish.$(br2)$(thing)Industry$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(thing)48 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Ancient Remnant.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Leviathan$(n)$(br2)Pays 9 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
